propositions: When a tracker's checked-out branch is not the published ref, the heal merges unrelated commits from the side branch into the ticket history via _fold_heads and publishes them via branch -f, corrupting the shared ref.
The heal must refuse (raising S3DoctorConflict) before downloading or merging any bundle when the tracker is not on the published ref or is detached.
The refusal guard must run after the single-bundle no-op check so stores with nothing to heal retain their no-op behavior.
When the tracker is correctly on the published ref, the heal must remain lossless and unchanged from pre-existing behavior.
A detached HEAD tracker must be refused by the same guard that checks for incorrect branch checkout.
The refusal must provide a hint message naming the required tracker state so operators can remediate.
